summary: core.user.created.v1 carries the created user's phone (optional E.164 string, absent when the user has none). The field is additive, so the event keeps its ID; it is sensitive under User.Read like the email, so the automation catalog removes it for authors and run history hides it from viewers without that permission. The native catalog snapshot (web/runtime/catalog/sdk-natives.json) and the example package's committed kit are regenerated from the current natives.
